# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

A simple HTML canvas game where the player controls a spaceship that moves left and right along the bottom of the screen. Asteroids fall from the top at random positions and speeds. The player must avoid them; each collision reduces a small health bar. The game ends (lose condition) when health reaches zero. The score is the time survived or number of asteroids dodged.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting canvas with id="game"
2: // Controls: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight or A/D keys
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width;
9:   const height = canvas.height;
10: 
11:   // generate starfield background
12:   const starCount = 100;
13:   const stars = [];
14:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
15:     stars.push({
16:       x: Math.random() * width,
17:       y: Math.random() * height,
18:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
19:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
20:     });
21:   }
22: 
23:   // sound effects (small data URLs)
24:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // silent placeholder
25:   const spawnSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
26:   const gameOverSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
27: 
28:   const ship = {
29:     w: 40,
30:     h: 20,
31:     x: width / 2 - 20,
32:     y: height - 30,
33:     speed: 5,
34:     color: '#0ff',
35:   };
36: 
37:   let asteroids = [];
38:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
39:   let lastSpawn = 0;
40: 
41:   let health = 3;
42:   let score = 0;
43:   let lastTime = 0;
44: 
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
48: 
49:   function spawnAsteroid() {
50:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
51:     asteroids.push({
52:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
53:       y: -size,
54:       w: size,
55:       h: size,
56:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
57:       color: '#f55',
58:     });
59:     // play spawn sound
60:     spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
61:     spawnSound.play();
62:   }
63: 
64:   function update(dt) {
65:     // ship movement
66:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
67:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
68:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
69: 
70:     // asteroids
71:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
72:     // update starfield (move stars downward for parallax effect)
73:     stars.forEach(s => {
74:       s.y += 0.2; // slow drift
75:       if (s.y > height) {
76:         s.y = 0;
77:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
78:       }
79:     });
80:     // remove off‑screen
81:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y < height);
82: 
83:     // collision detection
84:     for (const a of asteroids) {
85:       if (
86:         a.x < ship.x + ship.w &&
87:         a.x + a.w > ship.x &&
88:         a.y < ship.y + ship.h &&
89:         a.y + a.h > ship.y
90:       ) {
91:         health--;
92:         // play crash sound
93:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
94:         crashSound.play();
95:         // remove this asteroid
96:         a.y = height + 1;
97:         if (health <= 0) {
98:           // game over – stop animation
99:           cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
100:           // play game over sound
101:           gameOverSound.currentTime = 0;
102:           gameOverSound.play();
103:           alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
104:           return;
105:         }
106:       }
107:     }
108:     // score as time survived
109:     score += dt / 1000;
110:   }
111: 
112:   function draw() {
113:     // background gradient
114:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
115:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
116:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
117:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
118:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
119: 
120:     // starfield
121:     stars.forEach(s => {
122:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha})`;
123:       ctx.beginPath();
124:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
125:       ctx.fill();
126:     });
127: 
128:     // ship as triangle
129:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
130:     ctx.beginPath();
131:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
132:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
133:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
134:     ctx.closePath();
135:     ctx.fill();
136: 
137:     // asteroids with slight shading
138:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
139:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
140:         a.x + a.w / 2,
141:         a.y + a.h / 2,
142:         a.w * 0.1,
143:         a.x + a.w / 2,
144:         a.y + a.h / 2,
145:         a.w / 2
146:       );
147:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f88');
148:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
149:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     });
154: 
155:     // health bar with gradient
156:     const healthGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 10);
157:     healthGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
158:     healthGrad.addColorStop(1, '#050');
159:     ctx.fillStyle = healthGrad;
160:     for (let i = 0; i < health; i++) {
161:       ctx.fillRect(10 + i * 15, 10, 10, 10);
162:     }
163: 
164:     // score
165:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
167:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), width - 100, 20);
168:   }
169: 
170:   let animId;
171:   function loop(timestamp) {
172:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
173:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
174:     lastTime = timestamp;
175:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
176:       spawnAsteroid();
177:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
178:     }
179:     update(dt);
180:     draw();
181:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
182:   }
183: 
184:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185: })();

(End of file - total 185 lines)
</content>
